uncited: These methods distinguish themselves from sibling techniques by either dynamically scaling splat size and energy for distant voxels [Splatting for Anti-aliasing Small Cells](829-splatting-for-anti-aliasing-small-cells.md), or by hybridizing polygonal slicing with ellipsoidal splats to handle geometric detail and low-density regions simultaneously [Threshold Slicing and Anti-Aliasing](1447-threshold-slicing-and-anti-aliasing.md).
During wave surfing, if a voxel column is projected below the previous one, a crest is detected.
